summary: Research phase deliverables are in place and pass the draft verify (no errors). They were first written in an earlier attempt that used the wrong model (Haiku). In this Sonnet run I re-checked two sources live and left the files unchanged. The AdamW 2.15 docs confirm the defaults (lr 1e-3, weight_decay 1e-2) and the decoupled decay θ ← θ − γλθ applied before the moment updates. The Nanda sequence index confirms the four post titles; the post bodies were not read. I did not re-fetch the other seven ledger sources (arXiv papers, sklearn, UCI, safetensors, prior-run READMEs). I did not train anything or run study.py.
issues: The Nanda post bodies were not read, only the sequence index.
The prior-run summaries (src-prior-haiku, src-prior-luna) were recorded by the earlier Haiku attempt and not re-fetched in this Sonnet run.
The earlier attempt's sources.json and research.md were reused rather than rewritten.
study.py check, the pilot and the experiments are deferred to later phases.
objective: Literature review and source ledger for the digits weight-decay replication, with highlights, predictions and alternative explanations recorded before any experiment.
predictions: P1: the paired accuracy difference for weight decay 0.01 vs 0 is 0 or within ±0.6 pp, with a CI containing or equal to zero, so the result is inconclusive.
P2: the wd=0.001 sensitivity arm is indistinguishable from the other two.
P3: shuffled-label accuracy is near chance (~0.1), class-prior ~0.10, logistic ~0.95-0.96, MLP ~0.96-0.97.
Falsifier: a CI wholly below zero contradicts h1. A CI wholly above zero would prompt a bug check first, as would shuffled-label accuracy well above chance.
alternatives: The null comes from weak decay (lr·wd = 1e-5 per step) rather than from a ceiling effect (~97% accuracy on 360 test points).
Identical predictions could mean decay is not actually applied (an ordinary bug).
The prior runs agree because they share code and data, so they are not independent replications.
Random-split writer overlap makes the results optimistic.
observations: The AdamW 2.15 docs show decoupled decay applied outside the moment estimates, with defaults lr 1e-3 and wd 1e-2.
Both prior runs report identical accuracies across the decay arms (0.9639/0.9694/0.9694 at seeds 0/1/2) and a degenerate CI [0,0].
load_digits is the 1797-sample UCI test subset without writer IDs.
The verify command reported no errors.
learning: The expected outcome is a null result. The next phases should compare weights and loss histories across arms to rule out a bug where decay is not applied. All conclusions stay exploratory because the prior results are known.
rationale: The ledger and reports are consistent with the live sources I re-checked and they pass verification, so the next action is to move on to the core phase and run study.py check.
